name: Moc Chau food guide
summary: Cơm lam is sticky rice cooked in a bamboo tube, named at Ban Ang. The plate shown here was not taken in Moc Chau. Yogurt, hau plum, plateau tea, grilled fish, smoked meat, forest greens, and rice wine from a gourd are the other names on the plateau list. The night market is the ground around the Pha Luong light park. Prices and hours are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Moc Chau food — bamboo sticky rice at Ban Ang
